purpose: Stable runtime event/query extension for research classification, compartmentalization, compromise interpretation, and declassification. Security/Intelligence owns how access is attacked or defended; Adaptive Research owns research-side access/dissemination consequences.

external_input_events.payload: target record/project/asset ref, access class, existence-disclosure policy, authorized group/context refs, external release policy
external_input_events.effect: update authorized research participation and future dissemination only; scientific maturity unchanged

external_input_events.payload: target/context + factual security service availability or degradation
external_input_events.effect: update concrete secure participation/storage/communications blockers; no generic secrecy bonus

external_input_events.payload: affected record/asset/project refs, known scope, provenance, confidence, known recipients if legitimately established
external_input_events.effect: update owner known-compromise state and create research evidence/asset consequences only for known factual scope

external_input_events.payload: recipient polity/context + exact acquired record/asset classes, provenance, integrity, source lineage
external_input_events.effect: route acquired material through evidence/tacit/foreign-tech interpretation; never instant native maturity
update who can actually access/use the asset; policy labels do not move the physical object
reuse legitimate foreign-capability observation/assessment path without revealing implementation records

external_input_events.payload: target refs + new access/external release policy + authorization
external_input_events.effect: expand normal dissemination according to real communication paths and archive rules; maturity unchanged

external_queries.output: yes/no/partial plus known authorization reason; does not bypass physical availability
eligible authorized Effective Research Labs/facilities/expert assets only
authorized known policy, resilience, material blockers, and known compromise state only
known suspected/confirmed/unknown-scope assessment with provenance/confidence; never omniscient recipient list
authorized contexts newly eligible for dissemination, archive-resilience change, known coordination effects; maturity unchanged
legitimate Understanding/Operability/Reproduction/Adaptation consequences using existing foreign-tech model

project_integration.assignment_rule: A classified/compartmented project can assign only Effective Research Labs, facilities, expert/tacit assets, and contexts that are both scientifically eligible and security-authorized/physically available.
project_integration.independent_validation: If a project/stage genuinely requires independent replication/review, restricted authorized institutions must actually provide it; otherwise show a concrete validation/readiness blocker.
project_integration.compartment_integration: Engineering work requiring multiple compartments needs an authorized integration context; missing integration access blocks the relevant work rather than multiplying RP cost.
project_integration.result_rule: A project result initially inherits its configured security policy/compartment distribution and then disseminates only through authorized real paths.

compromise_integration.owner_knowledge_rule: The owner only knows a compromise/recipient to the degree external intelligence/security evidence establishes it.
compromise_integration.recipient_rule: Acquired material becomes records/evidence/tacit/foreign assets with real scope and provenance; it never directly sets native technology Mature.
compromise_integration.partial_record_rule: A recipient may gain theory/blueprints while lacking protocols/tooling/experts/facilities, producing asymmetric foreign-tech assessment rather than one stolen-tech boolean.
compromise_integration.observation_rule: Observed deployed capability may create evidence/pressure/foreign assessment without any compromised record at all.

view_extension.foreign_or_unauthorized_view: Only legitimately known rumor/evidence/observed capability/acquired records. Never project authoritative classification metadata merely because it exists.
